credits.title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
credits.overview: When a forbidden Indonesian exorcism is broadcast live online, it unleashes a legendary demonic entity across Asia, forcing the grieving son of a Taiwanese victim to trace the curse back to its ancient, blood-soaked roots in rural Indonesia before it consumes everyone in its digital wake.

credits.title: Devil's Market
credits.overview: Disgraced by a public backlash after producing fraudulent paranormal content, an ambitious video blogger ventures into a legendary, forbidden forest to capture authentic supernatural evidence, only to become permanently ensnared within a malevolent metaphysical realm.
